package.description: Yet Another Key Caster — cross-platform key & mouse click visualizer.

en-US.description: Yet Another Key Caster — cross-platform key & mouse click visualizer.
en-US.longDescription: YAKC (Yet Another Key Caster) is an open-source, cross-platform key & mouse click visualizer for streamers, content creators, teachers and presenters. It displays your keystrokes and mouse clicks as customizable on-screen popups, with any keyboard language supported automatically.
en-US.name: YAKC
